facts.author: Nik Koios
facts.headline: The San Diego Mosque Attack and the Unraveling of Neo-Nazi Accelerationism
facts.summary: When two teenagers attacked the Islamic Center of San Diego, the sharpest verdict on their neo-Nazi accelerationism came from opposite ends of the extremist world: established white-supremacist networks disowned them, and Islamic State channels called their worldview 'TikTok ideology.' Both saw the same thing — violence assembled from online debris rather than doctrine.
